mapper.select: SELECT j.* FROM material_analysis_jobs j WHERE ((j.status = 'QUEUED' AND j.next_run_at <= #{now}) OR (j.status = 'RUNNING' AND j.lease_until IS NOT NULL AND j.lease_until < #{now})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_analysis_controls c WHERE c.user_id = j.user_id AND c.paused = 1) AND j.priority >= #{minPriority} ORDER BY j.priority ASC, j.next_run_at ASC, j.job_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{owner}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, lease_token = lease_token + 1, attempt = attempt + 1, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND ((status = 'QUEUED' AND next_run_at <= #{now}) OR (status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < #{now}))
UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET total_chunks = #{totalChunks}, completed_chunks = #{completedChunks}, checkpoint_json = #{checkpointJson} WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, result_ref_id = #{resultRefId}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'QUEUED', next_run_at = #{nextRunAt}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'QUEUED', attempt = 0, priority = #{priority}, next_run_at = #{now}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, finished_at = NULL WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('FAILED', 'UNAVAILABLE', 'PARTIAL', 'PAUSED', 'CANCELLED', 'DONE')
UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'QUEUED', next_run_at = #{now} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PAUSED'
UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'PAUSED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'QUEUED'

UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = NOW(), lease_token = lease_token + 1 WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED')

UPDATE material_analysis_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', finished_at = NOW(), lease_token = lease_token + 1 WHERE material_id = #{materialId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND job_kind = 'LINK' AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PAUSED')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_analysis_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY job_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM material_analysis_jobs WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND attempt > 0 AND updated_at >= #{since}

SELECT j.job_id, j.user_id, j.material_id, l.course_id AS course_id, j.job_kind, j.file_hash, j.analysis_version, j.priority, j.status, j.attempt, j.max_attempts, j.next_run_at, j.lease_owner, j.lease_until, j.lease_token, j.total_chunks, j.completed_chunks, j.checkpoint_json, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.result_ref_id, j.created_at, j.updated_at, j.finished_at FROM material_analysis_jobs j JOIN material_links l ON l.material_id = j.material_id AND l.user_id = j.user_id JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = l.course_id AND c.user_id = l.user_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN course_materials cm ON cm.material_id = j.material_id AND cm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND cm.file_hash = j.file_hash WHERE j.job_kind = 'CONTENT' AND j.course_id = 0 AND j.status IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL') AND j.analysis_version = #{analysisVersion} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM material_analysis_jobs k WHERE k.material_id = j.material_id AND k.course_id = l.course_id AND k.job_kind = 'LINK' AND k.file_hash = j.file_hash AND k.analysis_version = j.analysis_version) ORDER BY j.finished_at ASC, j.job_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
